thread:
alex (sales): Heads-up — skyline.ai POC next Tuesday. They need a two-region dedicated pool (us-west + eu-west) with a short surge window: baseline 4 GPUs, spike to 16 for 4h. Also want scoped hosted keys for 3 devs and a minimal runbook. Can we do without changing commits?

julia (solutions): Yes, surge billed on-demand if no commit. We can do an autoscale override for the window. They requested q8_0 pinned for the demo.

chris (eng-ops): We'll need exact window (ISO) and CIDRs for ACL. Recommend enabling KV prefix caching and pin to quantized variant to reduce memory.

mohit (eng-infra): I can provision namespaced pool and apply a surge_override. Example fields I use are start/end, baseline, max, model_pin, cache=true. Will check eu-west quotas.

alex (sales): Window: 2026-04-07T14:00:00Z to 2026-04-07T18:00:00Z. CIDRs: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.8/29. Please create 3 scoped tokens labeled skyline-dev-1..3.

eva (security): POC allowances: rotate tokens within 24h after window, set logs retention to 30 days, redact streaming payloads for any potential PII. Provide customer contact for allowlist.

infra-bot: quota-check: eu-west availability: +12 GPUs available.

mohit (eng-infra): Created pool rp-9407-us and rp-9407-eu and applied surge_override. Hosted tokens issued: skyline-dev-1, skyline-dev-2, skyline-dev-3 (rotating). Runbook posted: https://redwood.internal/poc/rp-9407/playbook (includes sample curl and metrics dashboard).

chris (eng-ops): ACLs and CIDRs applied. KV caching enabled and model pinned to skyline-q8_0-v1. We'll monitor metrics during the 4h window and notify if any throttling or OOMs show up.

ajex (sales): Thanks team! I'll send tokens + playbook to customer. Please confirm token rotation after the demo.

mohit (eng-infra): Will rotate tokens 2026-04-08T20:00:00Z and confirm here.

eva (security): Confirmed logs retention set to 30 days and redaction rules applied.

alex (sales): Great — demo prep done :rocket:
